title: Emboshield® and Xact® Post Approval Carotid Stent Trial (The EXACT Study)
brief_summary: To collect clinical outcome and device performance data on the FDA 510(k)-cleared Emboshield® BareWire™ Rapid Exchange Embolic Protection System and FDA-approved Xact® Rapid Exchange Carotid Stent System when used under commercial use conditions by a broad group of physicians entering the study with differing carotid artery stenting experiences.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who agree to participate in this study and have signed the IRB approved informed consent form.
* Subjects who are willing to have the Emboshield and/or the Xact inserted into the their vasculature.

Exclusion Criteria:

* There are no exclusion criteria for this study.
